text:
Situation: Spironolactone 100 mg tablets are low at Corvale East with 106 tablets on hand covering 8.5 days at current use of 12.5 tablets per day. Corvale General holds 375 tablets covering 27 days at 13.9 tablets per day. Corvale Lakeside has 28 tablets of 25 mg strength covering 10 days. The 25 mg strength at Corvale East has 242 tablets covering 17.9 days and at Corvale General 302 tablets covering 22.1 days.

Why (FDA record): As of 2026-10-21, FDA's drug shortage list does not include spironolactone. The drug is marked "To Be Discontinued" with no date provided.

Our position: Internal supply can cover the gap at Corvale East through a transfer. Alternate manufacturers are available and not on FDA's shortage list today.

Recommended actions:
1. Transfer 69 tablets of 100 mg from Corvale General to Corvale East — approved by pharmacy director.
2. Place orders with Accord Healthcare, Inc. — approved by buyer.
3. Place orders with Advagen Pharma Ltd. — approved by buyer.
4. Place orders with Amneal Pharmaceuticals LLC — approved by buyer.
5. Place orders with Amneal Pharmaceuticals of New York LLC — approved by buyer.

Not recommended: No clinical dosing changes or therapeutic substitutions at this time.
